svg.title: Kaizen
svg.desc: From any session, you or the session itself propose a fix for friction or a bug with /bip-kaizen. The bipartite session weighs it, a cold reviewer and the sender check the diff, and it lands once CI is green. Skills are symlinked, so every session uses the fix from its next invocation.
svg.text: or the session itself, hits friction or a bug and runs /bip-kaizen:
what happened, the root cause, a proposed edit
the proposal, quoting any words of yours;
operations go ahead, science waits for you
weighs it: lean by default, and deleting beats adding;
a rule must name a failure someone actually hit;
places it, and may push back or ask for an A/B first
for a trim: old file against new
CI green at the head, then land
skills are symlinked, so the next
